snippet.title: Paddle Legends Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4076450/Paddle_Legends/

Paddle Legends is a retro arcade roguelite game. 

Unlock paddles, grab upgrades, and add new ball abilities as you battle through dynamic levels, obstacles, and bosses across three campaigns and an endless mode.

#indiegame #roguelite #steam #retrogaming
